The '''BAF-1000 Assault Droid''' was a bipedal [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. BAF-1000 Assault Droids were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and were among the forces used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to defend the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].
